customManagers.description: The pin of the JS reference: the newest Mermaid release its commit contains, and the commit. A new mermaid@ release opens a pull request that moves both; its CI shows what is new (docs/decisions/0014-upstream-reference-at-a-pin.md).

packageRules.description: Updates of the harness and of CI are chores, not fixes that release-please would publish as a release (docs/decisions/0003-conventional-commits.md).
The harness's lint, format and type check, with its pre-commit hook (tools/port).
What the harness runs the reference with: tsx, the browser, the DOM, the bundlers and YAML.

The harness reads the strings of the upstream tests with TypeScript's compiler API (tools/port/inputs.ts), which TypeScript 7, the native compiler, does not offer. TypeScript stays on 6, the last release with that API.
The harness reads YAML as the reference does, and Mermaid 12.2.0 reads it with js-yaml 4; js-yaml 5 parses differently (port-diff yaml). Raise the limit when the pinned Mermaid moves to js-yaml 5.
Node.js and pnpm, which CI and the harness run on.
The font and text crates of ferrigura-text, which move together.
The binding crates of the Node addon.

One pull request per Mermaid minor release, opened without approval in the Dependency Dashboard so that a release is not missed, and merged by hand: moving the pin can need rebased patches and pending exceptions. The pin may sit a few commits after its release, so it gets no digest updates.
prBodyNotes: Moving the pin: run `tools/reference/setup.sh`, rebase or drop the patches that no longer apply, and fix every new difference or make it a pending exception with its issue (`tools/reference/README.md`).

packageRules.description: sebastian-software/standards tags its releases standards-vX.Y.Z, which the versioning of GitHub Actions does not take for versions; the comment after the digest names the tag.
